blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】作業負荷を考慮してみる
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Considering Workload

blocks.source: １つの作品を完成させるためには、様々な作業が必要となる。そして、その作業毎に制作者が感じる心理的・時間的な負荷は異なる。作品の完成を目指すに当たって、各作業の負荷を考慮してみたい。
blocks.translation: Completing a single project requires a wide variety of tasks. The psychological and time-related burden the creator feels varies from task to task. As I work toward completing a project, I want to consider the workload of each task.

blocks.source: 作品を完成できない制作者にありがちなのは、負荷が大きい作業を避けて、負荷が小さい作業に逃げてしまうこと。
blocks.translation: A common habit among creators who cannot finish their projects is avoiding tasks with a heavy workload and escaping into tasks with a lighter one.

blocks.source: （ソースは僕の少年時代）
blocks.translation: (Based on my childhood experience)

blocks.source: 特に素材収集に加え、仲間・敵・アイテム等のデータ入力といった簡単な作業をして、制作を進めた気になってしまうのは大きな罠だ。
blocks.translation: In particular, it is a major trap to work on simple tasks such as collecting resources and entering data for party members, enemies, items, and so on, and end up feeling as though you have made progress.

blocks.source: 負荷が大きい作業とは、以下のような傾向が強いものである。
blocks.translation: Tasks with a heavy workload tend to have the following characteristics.

blocks.source: 作業量が多い。
blocks.translation: A large amount of work.

blocks.source: 結果を得るまで時間がかかる。
blocks.translation: They take a long time to produce results.

blocks.source: 創造力が必要。
blocks.translation: They require creativity.

blocks.source: 技術力が必要。
blocks.translation: They require technical skill.

blocks.source: 複雑な計算が必要。
blocks.translation: They require complex calculations.

blocks.source: 負荷が小さい作業とは、以下のような傾向が強いものである。
blocks.translation: Tasks with a light workload tend to have the following characteristics.

blocks.source: 作業量が少ない。
blocks.translation: A small amount of work.

blocks.source: 結果が出るのが早い。
blocks.translation: They produce results quickly.

blocks.source: 単純作業。
blocks.translation: Repetitive work.

blocks.source: 例えば、『マップデータの作成』は１つのダンジョンや町を完成させるまでに長い時間がかかるため、完成までモチベーションを維持することが難しい。一度、区切りがついた場合に再開するのにも気力を要する。
blocks.translation: For example, creating map data takes a long time to complete a single dungeon or town, making it difficult to maintain motivation until it is finished. Even restarting after reaching a stopping point requires considerable effort.

blocks.source: 逆に『町人の配置＆セリフ作成』などは、１人当たりのセリフ入力はすぐに終わるので、気軽に手をつけて気軽に中断・再開しやすい。
blocks.translation: By contrast, tasks such as placing townspeople and writing their dialogue are easy to start, pause, and resume, since entering one person's dialogue is quickly finished.

blocks.source: だからといって、負荷が大きい作業に手を付けないことには、制作はいつまで経っても進んだとは言えないし、終わらない。
blocks.translation: That said, if you never tackle tasks with a heavy workload, you cannot truly say that development is progressing, and it will never be finished.

blocks.source: 負荷が小さい作業というのは、モチベーションが低い時でもできる。平日、仕事帰りの疲れた時でも、惰性で少しずつ進めやすい。ある程度の型を決めたならば、後回しにしてもよいだろう。
blocks.translation: Tasks with a light workload can be done even when your motivation is low. Even on weekdays, when you are tired after work, they are easy to make incremental progress on out of sheer inertia. Once you have established a general template, you can leave them for later.

blocks.source: 制作者の好みによって負荷の大小が変化することは言うまでもないけれど、参考までに僕個人の主観で負荷の大小毎に項目を列挙してみた。
blocks.translation: Needless to say, the workload varies according to the creator's preferences, but for reference, I have listed tasks according to their workload based on my personal subjective judgment.

blocks.source: 負荷大
blocks.translation: Heavy Workload

blocks.source: ストーリーの作成
blocks.translation: Creating the Story

blocks.source: 全体のストーリーを構想し、さらに、テキストエディタへ個別イベントのセリフや所作といった脚本を打ち込んでいく。ＲＰＧ制作における醍醐味で、これを一番の楽しみとする制作者も多いが難易度も高い。
blocks.translation: You devise the overall story, then enter scripts such as the dialogue and actions for individual events into a text editor. This is one of the highlights of RPG development, and many creators consider it the most enjoyable part, but it is also quite difficult.

blocks.source: 言うまでもなく創造力を要する作業となるのだが、同時に物語の整合性を取る論理性も要求される。
blocks.translation: Needless to say, this work requires creativity, but it also demands the logical thinking needed to maintain the story's consistency.

blocks.source: 脚本を書いていると、色々と気恥ずかしくなってくるのも創作者として、乗り越えねばならない壁。しかし、そこは気にせず行こう。
blocks.translation: Feeling embarrassed about various things while writing a script is also an obstacle that creators must overcome. Still, don't worry about it and keep going.

blocks.source: 途中、考えたイベントが気に食わず、戻り作業が発生することも珍しくないので、しっかり構想を固めたい。
blocks.translation: It is not unusual to dislike an event you came up with along the way and have to redo your work, so you should solidify your plans carefully.

blocks.source: ただし、「構想段階で停滞して、いつまでたっても脚本に進まない」なんていうのもありがちなこと。構想がある程度できたのなら、意を決して脚本制作に進もう。
blocks.translation: However, it is also common to get stuck at the planning stage and never move on to writing the script. Once you have worked out your plans to a reasonable degree, make up your mind and move on to script development.

blocks.source: マップデータの作成
blocks.translation: Creating Map Data

blocks.source: 地道で時間がかかる作業の代表格。
blocks.translation: The quintessential tedious and time-consuming task.

blocks.source: ストーリーがないＲＰＧはあっても、マップがないＲＰＧは少ないので、個人制作ならば避けては通れない部分。
blocks.translation: While RPGs without stories do exist, RPGs without maps are rare, so this is an unavoidable part of solo development.

blocks.source: 膨大なマップデータを入力する面倒臭さに挫折した制作者は数知れず。
blocks.translation: Countless creators have given up because of the tedium of entering enormous amounts of map data.

blocks.source: ストーリーと比べるとそこまでの創造力は要求されず、単調作業寄り。そのため、やる気がなくても、ある程度やれるという点だけはマシだろう。ただし、下にある『マップチップの作成』段階からやる場合はその限りではない。
blocks.translation: Compared with the story, this does not require as much creativity and leans more toward repetitive work. For that reason, it is at least manageable to some extent even when you are not motivated. However, that does not apply if you are starting from the map tile creation stage described below.

blocks.source: ストーリーイベントの作成
blocks.translation: Creating Story Events

blocks.source: 作成した脚本をイベントとしてエディタのマップ上に乗せると同時に、キャラクターの配置・動作や画面演出といったものを組み込む。
blocks.translation: You place the completed script on the editor's map as an event while also incorporating character placement, movement, and screen direction.

blocks.source: 指定した動作で実際に動かしてみると、しっくり来ないことが多く、何度も調整を入れることが多い。
blocks.translation: When you actually run it with the specified movements, it often does not feel right, so you frequently have to make adjustments over and over.

blocks.source: これもストーリーそのものの作成に負けずと大変な作業となる。
blocks.translation: This is also an extremely demanding task, no less so than creating the story itself.

blocks.source: 自作システム作成
blocks.translation: Creating Custom Systems

blocks.source: 複雑なスクリプトやプログラムによる自作システムの作成を指す。
blocks.translation: This refers to creating custom systems using complex scripts or programs.

blocks.source: 技術力が必要なのもさることながら、細かいレイアウトの調整も入ってくるので、中々に大変。システムデザインそのものも創造力を要する作業だ。
blocks.translation: In addition to requiring technical skill, it also involves fine-tuning the layout, making it quite difficult. System design itself is a task that requires creativity.

blocks.source: 敵グラフィックの作成
blocks.translation: Creating Enemy Graphics

blocks.source: グラフィック素材の中では、サイズが大きめなのが難しい点。画力が必要なので素人（僕含む）には辛い。巨大なボスモンスターは特に厳しい。
blocks.translation: Among graphic assets, the large size is the difficult part. Since drawing ability is required, it is tough for amateurs (myself included). Huge boss monsters are especially challenging.

blocks.source: あまり大きいと大変なので、最初は５０×５０ドットぐらいのサイズを目安に描いてみると良いと思う。
blocks.translation: Since making them too large is difficult, I recommend starting by drawing them at around 50×50 pixels.

blocks.source: ※あくまでＳＦＣ的な低解像度で作る場合の話です。
blocks.translation: ※This assumes that you are creating them at the low resolution of an SFC-style game.

blocks.source: １グラフィックに付き×３～４程度、色変えを駆使して数を水増ししてみよう。ボスまで色変えで済ませるというわけには、さすがにいかないが、長編でも４０～７０程度描けば何とかなる。
blocks.translation: Try increasing the number of graphics by making about ×3~4 variations of each graphic and using color changes to diversify them. You cannot get away with using color changes even for bosses, but even for a long game, drawing around 40~70 should be enough.

blocks.source: 歩行グラフィックの作成
blocks.translation: Creating Walking Graphics

blocks.source: 敵グラと比較すると、フォーマットがあるので描いている内に慣れやすい。素人でも少し頑張れば、そこそこの見栄えのものを作ることができる。キャラクターのデザインを考える楽しさもあるので、ドット絵初心者にもお勧め。
blocks.translation: Compared with enemy graphics, these are easier to get used to drawing because they follow a set format. Even amateurs can create reasonably good-looking graphics with a little effort. Since designing the characters is also enjoyable, I recommend this to beginners at pixel art.

blocks.source: ただし、上下左右それぞれの歩行パターンがいるのが大変。一般人の老若男女を揃えるだけでも一苦労だ。
blocks.translation: However, it is difficult because you need walking patterns for up, down, left, and right. Even assembling a full set of ordinary people of all ages and genders is a major undertaking.

blocks.source: マップチップの作成
blocks.translation: Creating Map Tiles

blocks.source: グラフィック素材の中では地味かつ大変。世界観に凝って「単純な西洋ファンタジーとは一線を画したものを作ろう」とか、こだわり出すと死ねる。パターンを使いまわしして、色を変えるだけでも雰囲気は変わるのでうまくやろう。
blocks.translation: Among graphic assets, this is both unglamorous and difficult. If you become particular about the setting and start thinking, “I want to create something that stands apart from simple Western fantasy,” you can work yourself to death. Reusing patterns and merely changing their colors can also change the atmosphere, so make the most of that.

blocks.source: 戦闘アニメーションの作成
blocks.translation: Creating Battle Animations

blocks.source: 自力で素材制作を行わない場合は、負荷中ぐらいになると思う。とにかくパターンが多い。サイドビューならば、キャラクターの動きを作らなければならないのが大変。
blocks.translation: If you are not creating the assets yourself, I think the workload would be around medium. In any case, there are a lot of patterns. With side-view battles, having to create the characters' movements is particularly difficult.

blocks.source: ちなみに、ＦＦ６やロマサガ３のキャラの戦闘アニメを見ると分かるが、うまく歩行アニメーションを流用して手間を削減していたりする。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, you can see from the battle animations for characters in FFVI and Romancing SaGa 3 that they cleverly reused walking animations to reduce the amount of work.

blocks.source: 作曲
blocks.translation: Music Composition

blocks.source: 意外かもしれないが、素材制作の中では比較的に負荷は小さい部類だと思う。どの程度こだわるかにもよるが、５～１０時間程度あれば一曲完成できたりする。
blocks.translation: This may be surprising, but I think it is among the less demanding types of asset creation. It depends on how particular you are, but you can sometimes complete a song in around 5–10 hours.

blocks.source: ※この文章は当初ＭＩＤＩをそのまま使っていた時代に書いたものです。現代は良質な音源を使ってＯＧＧやＭＰ３を作成するのが大半なのでもっと大変です。
blocks.translation: ※This was originally written in the days when MIDI files were used as-is. Today, most people create OGG or MP3 files using high-quality sound sources, so it is even more difficult.

blocks.source: ＤＱシリーズのように長編でも曲の使い所を絞れば、数十曲でも足りる。ＦＦのように町・ダンジョン毎に曲を変える勢いだと大変。他と比べると成果物単体での達成感が大きいので、モチベーションにつながりやすい。
blocks.translation: As with the Dragon Quest series, even a long game can get by with a few dozen songs if you limit where they are used. It becomes difficult if you change the music for every town and dungeon, as in Final Fantasy. Compared with other types of work, each finished piece provides a greater sense of accomplishment, making it easier to stay motivated.

blocks.source: ただし、スランプやマンネリに陥ると、中々脱出できないのがこれの難しいところ。
blocks.translation: However, the difficult part is that once you fall into a slump or a rut, it can be very hard to get out of it.

blocks.source: 負荷中
blocks.translation: Medium Workload

blocks.source: テストプレイ（デバッグ＆バランス調整）
blocks.translation: Playtesting (Debugging & Balance Adjustments)

blocks.source: 長編となると、クリアまで数十時間とかかったりするので、１周通してクリアするだけでもかなりの負担となる。
blocks.translation: In a long game, it can take dozens of hours to reach the ending, so even completing one full playthrough is a considerable burden.

blocks.source: その上で、『マップの当たり判定』『フラグ管理』『バランス調整』といった細部に気を配る必要がある。
blocks.translation: On top of that, you need to pay attention to details such as map collision detection, flag management, and balance adjustments.

blocks.source: 実際は完成までに数周はテストプレイするのが常識。自分のゲームは既に知り尽くしているがために、やっていてもワクワク感が少なく、言わば最初から半分飽きている状態なので、これも中々の苦行。
blocks.translation: In practice, it is standard to playtest the game several times before completion. Since I already know my own game inside and out, playing it is not very exciting; in a sense, I am already half tired of it from the start. This makes playtesting quite grueling as well.

blocks.source: 町人の配置＆セリフ作成
blocks.translation: Placing Townspeople & Writing Dialogue

blocks.source: 長編なら店等の施設を省いた全部の町人を合計すると、何百人という人数になる。
blocks.translation: In a long game, the total number of townspeople, excluding those working at facilities such as shops, can reach several hundred.

blocks.source: さらにストーリーの進行によって、セリフが切り替わったりする。これら全部のセリフを入力するのは地味に大変だが、１人当たりの作業はそこまで多くない。作業を区切りやすいので、気持ちとしては楽にできる。
blocks.translation: Their dialogue may also change as the story progresses. Entering all of this dialogue is tedious in its own way, but there is not that much work per person. Since the work is easy to divide into sections, it feels relatively manageable.

blocks.source: ただし、会話のネタ切れに悩まされることも……。
blocks.translation: However, you may also struggle with running out of ideas for conversations…

blocks.source: 負荷小
blocks.translation: Low Workload

blocks.source: 素材収集
blocks.translation: Collecting Assets

blocks.source: フリー素材を集めて来ただけで、何だか制作が進んだ気になるのは良くあること。ただそれが錯覚であることも言うまでもない。
blocks.translation: It is common to feel as though development has progressed just because you collected some free assets. Needless to say, however, that feeling can be an illusion.

blocks.source: 人にオーダーメイドする場合は、やり取りによる負荷は大きくなる。
blocks.translation: If you commission custom work from someone, the workload involved in communicating back and forth becomes greater.

blocks.source: なお、「グラフィック素材の色変え・反転」や「音楽素材のループ処理」など、最低限の編集技術は身に着けておきたい。何でも人頼みで完成できるほど、ゲーム制作は易しくない。
blocks.translation: You should also acquire at least the basic editing skills, such as changing or flipping the colors of graphic assets and processing loops for music assets. Game development is not easy enough to complete by relying on other people for everything.

blocks.source: 仲間パラメータの入力
blocks.translation: Entering Party Member Parameters

blocks.source: 各キャラクターに能力を設定し、個性付けを行う。
blocks.translation: Set each character's abilities and give them their own individuality.

blocks.source: 人数は多くても普通は数十人程度なので、作業量としてはさほど多くない。
blocks.translation: Even in a large party, there are usually only a few dozen characters, so the amount of work is not particularly large.

blocks.source: 敵パラメータの入力＆配置
blocks.translation: Entering & Placing Enemy Parameters

blocks.source: 数は多いがザコ一体当たりの作業量は数分～１０分程度といった所か。
blocks.translation: There may be many of them, but the work required for each ordinary enemy is probably around a few minutes to 10 minutes.

blocks.source: ただし、ボス敵については何度もテストプレイを繰り返しながら、調整する必要あり。
blocks.translation: However, bosses need to be adjusted through repeated playtesting.

blocks.source: アイテム・技データの作成
blocks.translation: Creating Item & Skill Data

blocks.source: 基本的には名前と数値を入力していくだけの地味で簡単な作業。
blocks.translation: Basically, it is a plain and simple task of entering names and numerical values.

blocks.source: 戦闘アニメの作成と比較すると、遥かに楽。
blocks.translation: Compared with creating battle animations, it is far easier.

blocks.source: ただし、アイテムや技に個性付けするために、スクリプトに手を出したりするとそれなりの手間はかかる。
blocks.translation: However, if you start using scripts to give items and skills their own individuality, it will take a fair amount of extra work.

blocks.source: アイテムデータの配置
blocks.translation: Placing Item Data

blocks.source: いわゆる宝箱。町中のツボやタンスに物を置く場合もある。もちろん、これらの管理はきちんとやろう。
blocks.translation: This refers to so-called treasure chests. You may also place items in pots and dressers around town. Of course, be sure to manage all of this properly.

blocks.source: Excel等を使って、どこに何を置いたかはすぐに分かるようにしておく。町／ダンジョン名と配置したアイテムの対応表があれば良い。
blocks.translation: Use Excel or a similar tool so that you can quickly see what you placed and where. A table mapping town/dungeon names to the items placed there is sufficient.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 作品を完成させるため、特に重要となるのは『ストーリー』『ストーリーイベント』『マップデータ』の３点になる。これだけ抑えれば作品としての形はできるので、後は何とかなる。
blocks.translation: To complete a game, the three most important elements are the story, story events, and map data. If you take care of these, you will have the basic shape of a game, and you can manage the rest somehow.

blocks.source: システムについては、必ずしも自作する必要はもない。ツールのデフォルトでもよいし、プラグインやスクリプト素材のようなものを利用してもよい。素材については、オリジナリティは出ないかもしれないが、フリー素材だけでも完成させる事はできる。
blocks.translation: As for the systems, you do not necessarily need to create them yourself. You can use the tool's defaults, or use things such as plugins and script assets. As for the assets, you may not achieve much originality, but it is possible to complete a game using only free assets.

blocks.source: パラメータの入力だとか、ゲームバランスの調整だとか、町人や宝箱の設定だとかは、これらに比べればずっと作業量は少ない。なので、作品を完成させたことがないという方は、この重要な３点を優先して取り組んで見るとよいだろう。
blocks.translation: Entering parameters, adjusting the game balance, and setting up townspeople and treasure chests all require far less work than these elements. Therefore, if you have never completed a game, it would be a good idea to prioritize these three important elements.

blocks.source: もちろん、作品に対して味付けを行いたいならば、素材や自作システムにもこだわる必要があるのだが、それらはこの３点の形が出来上がってからでも遅くはない。
blocks.translation: Of course, if you want to add your own flavor to the game, you will need to be particular about the assets and custom systems as well. However, it is not too late to work on those after these three elements have taken shape.

texts.１つの作品を完成させるためには、様々な作業が必要となる。そして、その作業毎に制作: Completing a single project requires a wide variety of tasks. The psychological and time-related burden the creator feels varies from task to task. As I work toward completing a project, I want to consider the workload of each task.
texts.作品を完成できない制作者にありがちなのは、負荷が大きい作業を避けて、負荷が小さい: A common habit among creators who cannot finish their projects is avoiding tasks with a heavy workload and escaping into tasks with a lighter one.
texts.特に素材収集に加え、仲間・敵・アイテム等のデータ入力といった簡単な作業をして、制: In particular, it is a major trap to work on simple tasks such as collecting resources and entering data for party members, enemies, items, and so on, and end up feeling as though you have made progress.
texts.負荷が大きい作業とは、以下のような傾向が強いものである。: Tasks with a heavy workload tend to have the following characteristics.
texts.結果を得るまで時間がかかる。: They take a long time to produce results.
texts.負荷が小さい作業とは、以下のような傾向が強いものである。: Tasks with a light workload tend to have the following characteristics.
texts.例えば、『マップデータの作成』は１つのダンジョンや町を完成させるまでに長い時間が: For example, creating map data takes a long time to complete a single dungeon or town, making it difficult to maintain motivation until it is finished. Even restarting after reaching a stopping point requires considerable effort.
texts.逆に『町人の配置＆セリフ作成』などは、１人当たりのセリフ入力はすぐに終わるので、: By contrast, tasks such as placing townspeople and writing their dialogue are easy to start, pause, and resume, since entering one person's dialogue is quickly finished.
texts.だからといって、負荷が大きい作業に手を付けないことには、制作はいつまで経っても進: That said, if you never tackle tasks with a heavy workload, you cannot truly say that development is progressing, and it will never be finished.
texts.負荷が小さい作業というのは、モチベーションが低い時でもできる。平日、仕事帰りの疲: Tasks with a light workload can be done even when your motivation is low. Even on weekdays, when you are tired after work, they are easy to make incremental progress on out of sheer inertia. Once you have established a general template, you can leave them for later.
texts.制作者の好みによって負荷の大小が変化することは言うまでもないけれど、参考までに僕: Needless to say, the workload varies according to the creator's preferences, but for reference, I have listed tasks according to their workload based on my personal subjective judgment.

This is one of the highlights of RPG development, and many creators consider it the most enjoyable part, but it is also quite difficult.

As for the assets, you may not achieve much originality, but it is possible to complete a game using only free assets.
